notes: Available on the xAI API since 2026-08-12. V1 stores short-context pricing. Canonical Pricing V2 tiers model standard prompt tokens < 200K and long-context prompt tokens >= 200K. Total prompt tokens include cached and non-cached prompt tokens, and the selected tier applies to the whole request. The xAI model page marks Batch API as not supported, so Batch fields remain null.
